definitions.explanation: The part of the mind that influences thoughts and behavior without conscious awareness. Used in psychology, self-help, and everyday conversation about hidden motivations or feelings.

examples.japanese: {潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{働|はたら}きかける。
{潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える→影響を与える：26072_eikyouwoataeru⟧。

⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づくこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{第一歩|だいいっぽ}→第一歩：09671_daiippo⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that becoming aware of your own subconscious is the first step toward personal growth.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in both academic psychology and popular self-help contexts. Often discussed in relation to habits, biases, and personal development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{働|はたら}きかける (to work on the subconscious)
- {潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刷|す}り{込|こ}む→刷り込む：09009_surikomu⟧ (to imprint on the subconscious)
- {潜在|せんざい}{意識|いしき}⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (at a subconscious level)

- ⟦{顕在|けんざい}→顕在：18082_kenzai⟧⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧: conscious awareness — the opposite, referring to thoughts one is actively aware of
